title: Consume Znode events (message broker)
summary: React to Znode domain events by deriving from EventConsumer<ZnodeEvent> (MassTransit over RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus).
when_to_use: push data to an external system when something changes in Znode
run side effects after an order, product or account change
not_for: changing the outcome of the operation that raised the event (events are after the fact: use a method override for that)

contract.message_fields_per_kb: EventDataCode, EventDataId, EventId, EventModule, EventName, EventPayload (JSON string), EventTimeStamp, EventVersion, UserId, Source, TraceId
contract.registration: MessageBrokerStartup.RegisterMessageBroker(); extend the existing Consume method (branch on EventModule/EventName); webhooks: Dev Center > Manage Webhook Settings; add the Admin URL to ZnodeAdminURLCorsPolicy for webhook endpoints

docs.title: Znode Customization - How to use Znode Events

limitations: Delivery is asynchronous and at-least-once: make handlers idempotent
Requires the events feature to be enabled for the environment
platform_change_if: an event you need is not raised by Znode

unverified: the full list of event modules and names and per-event payload schemas (they are in an external spreadsheet that was not readable)
